messages.message: React Hook useEffect was passed a dependency list that is not an array literal. This means we can't statically verify whether you've passed the correct dependencies.

React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'renderFn'. Either include it or remove the dependency array. If 'renderFn' changes too often, find the parent component that defines it and wrap that definition in useCallback.

suggestions.desc: Update the dependencies array to be: [renderFn]
